about: Serres, Grčija (id serres): the circuit on the plain of the Strymon south-west of Serres in Central Macedonia, 3.186 km, 16 corners (docs/dirkalisca-celine.md, »Novih pet«), one lap. The direction: clockwise, as the relation and its oneway ways are drawn in OSM. The start line: OSM's raceway=start-finish (node 1938568752, the relation's start).
